RetryAfter.description: Optional: delay seconds or an IMF-fixdate HTTP date. Analyte waits at most 60 seconds; a malformed value or one over 64 characters is ignored.

WebhookId.description: Standard Webhooks 1.0.0 message ID: the body's delivery_id, the same on every retry.
WebhookId.name: webhook-id

WebhookSignature.description: Standard Webhooks 1.0.0 signatures: space-separated v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256> candidates over the exact bytes of id.timestamp.body. Accept any candidate that matches a trusted whsec_ secret, comparing in constant time.
WebhookSignature.name: webhook-signature

WebhookTimestamp.description: Standard Webhooks 1.0.0 send time in integer Unix seconds. Refuse one more than 300 seconds from your clock in either direction.
WebhookTimestamp.name: webhook-timestamp

Refused.description: The app refuses this document. Analyte parks the delivery with the app's detail for an operator; nothing is lost.

RetryLater.description: Busy or unavailable. Analyte retries the same ID and bytes with capped backoff.

Unauthorized.description: Wrong or missing key, signature or timestamp. Analyte pauses the destination for setup repair.

bearer.description: The destination's API key: 1 to 4096 printable ASCII characters (space to ~), on every request.

info.description: Contract version 1 (docs/contract/v1.md, ADR 0008). Analyte calls the lab app; the lab app never calls Analyte. Bodies are UTF-8 JSON of at most 1,048,576 bytes; unknown fields are ignored. Body schemas are in contract-v1.schema.json beside this file. Generated from the Rust contract types; do not edit by hand.
info.summary: The calls a lab app answers for Analyte: result deliveries, order events and the order feed.
info.title: Analyte app contract

post.description: One change of an order's state on a machine. An uncertain state means the outcome is unknown; it never asks for a resend.

200.description: Stored durably before answering. `accepted` for a new delivery ID, `duplicate` for a repeat with the same bytes. Analyte marks the delivery done.

404.description: Wrong destination URL. Analyte pauses the destination for setup repair; it never follows a redirect (3xx is treated the same way).

409.description: The delivery ID was already stored with different bytes or under the other endpoint. Analyte parks the delivery for an operator.

413.description: The app's body limit is below the contract's 1,048,576-byte document limit. Analyte pauses the destination for setup repair.

default.description: Any other status: Analyte parks the delivery for an operator.

get.description: Without a cursor: a paged full snapshot of the latest version of each order. With the last cursor: the changes since, including tombstones. Commit each page with its cursor; complete is true on the last page.

parameters.description: The next_cursor of the previous page or poll; opaque, at most 256 bytes.
parameters.name: cursor

400.description: A limit outside 1 to 100 or a cursor over 256 bytes.

410.description: The cursor is unknown or expired (one hour after it was made). Analyte reloads a complete snapshot.

post.description: One delivery of results read from one machine message. Store the delivery ID with its effects before answering 200, and answer a repeat of the same ID and bytes as duplicate. Key your test table on source.model and each part's test code.
